description: Individually packed guest amenities shown as shaving, dental and comb kits in kraft-paper sleeves. Confirm the contents and available pack options before quotation.

description: Compact guest dental-care items pictured with toothbrushes, toothpaste and a wrapped soap. Confirm the exact kit contents and quantities before quotation.

description: Table and coffee napkins shown with custom restaurant and event branding. Confirm paper quality, sizes, print options and order quantities before quotation.

name: Custom Sugar Sachets
description: Single-serve sugar sachets shown with custom hotel and restaurant branding. Confirm sugar type, sachet weight, print options and carton quantities before quotation.

description: Powder-free, non-sterile, single-use vinyl examination gloves shown in black, in boxes of 100 and Large size. Confirm sizes, colours and pack quantities before quotation.
